item.title: Morris: Minnesota’s fraud reckoning enters the influencer era
item.description: Nick Shirley’s viral video on X amplified outrage faster than verified facts could follow.

item.title: Minnesota DNR approves exploratory mineral drilling near Boundary Waters
item.description: The agency allowed the project for Franconia Minerals despite criticism from environmentalist groups.

item.title: Analysis: Will the Vikings be able to keep Brian Flores as their defensive coordinator?
item.description: Flores could get interviews for a head coaching job, but if he remains a coordinator, the Vikings might have to outbid other teams to keep him.

item.title: With launch day nearing, all eyes on Minnesota’s new paid leave program
item.description: Political stakes are high for success of the program, which mandates 12 weeks of paid family and medical leave.

item.title: Four TV journalists say goodbye to Twin Cities viewers
item.description: KARE’s Reggie Wilson and Fox 9’s Se Kwon are among the departures.

item.title: Police investigating overnight burglary of Somali day care in south Minneapolis
item.description: The break-in comes in the aftermath of a viral video alleging fraud by several Somali child care centers.

item.title: Trump administration says it's freezing child care funds to Minnesota after series of fraud schemes
item.description: President Donald Trump's administration announced on Tuesday that it's freezing child care funds to Minnesota and demanding an audit of some day care centers after a series of fraud schemes involving government programs in recent years.

item.title: What to know about the viral video that renewed scrutiny on fraud in Minnesota
item.description: Here’s what to know about the program at the center of the story, where the allegations came from and what state regulators have said in response.
